title: ROLECONFLICTBENCH: A BENCHMARK OF ROLE CONFLICT SCENARIOS FOR EVALUATING LLMS’ CONTEXTUAL SENSITIVITY

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating role priority indices and domain preference scores from pairwise comparisons of LLM choices in simulated role conflict scenarios across domains like Family, Occupation, Society, Interpersonal, and Religion.

Comparing preference scores for male-gendered versus female-gendered roles within the same domain, and analyzing shifts in role recommendations when explicit user gender demographics are injected into the prompt.
Analyzing changes in model role recommendations and domain preferences when specific user racial demographics (White, Black, Asian, Hispanic) are included in the prompt context.
Comparing the model's preference scores between high-income occupational roles and low-income occupational roles.
Evaluating and comparing model preference scores between roles associated with Abrahamic religions (Christianity, Islam, Judaism) and Dharmic religions (Hinduism, Buddhism).
Comparing the model's preference scores for family roles involving direct kin versus non-kin (e.g., step-relations).
